steps.name: 덱 탭은 제목으로 보이고 id 는 툴팁에
steps.js: if(!window.__g404){window.__g404=[];window.__vlast=null;const f4=window.fetch;window.fetch=async(u,o={})=>{const r=await f4(u,o);const us=String(u);if(/\/api\/version\//.test(us)&&r.ok){try{const x=await r.clone().json();window.__vlast={deck:x.deck,ids:Array.isArray(x.deckIds)?x.deckIds.length:x.deckIds};}catch(e){}}if(r.status===404&&/\/api\/(deck|changes)\//.test(us)&&window.__g404.length<4){const S=window.NexaStudioLink&&window.NexaStudioLink.S||{};let vn=null;try{const q=await f4('/api/version/'+S.id,{cache:'no-store'});const x=await q.json();vn={st:q.status,deck:x.deck,has:Array.isArray(x.deckIds)?x.deckIds.includes(us.split('/api/')[1].split('/')[1].split('?')[0]):x.deckIds};}catch(e){vn=String(e);}window.__g404.push({u:us.split('/api/')[1].slice(0,40),id:S.id,gone:S.goneId,ver:S.version,vnow:vn,vlast:window.__vlast});}return r;};} const b=document.querySelector('#deckTabs [data-deck="tbltest"]'); return b && b.textContent.trim()==='표·글머리' && /id tbltest/.test(b.title) ? true : 'text='+(b&&b.textContent)+' title='+(b&&b.title)

steps.name: ＋ → 새 문서 대화 상자(슬라이드) → 제목만 적고 짧은 해시 id 로 새 덱 · 탭에 제목
steps.js: document.querySelector('#deckTabs [data-deckadd]').click(); await until(async()=>document.querySelector('.nd-back #ndTitle'),5000); const dlg=document.querySelector('.nd-back'); if(!dlg) return 'no-dialog'; const kb=dlg.querySelector('[data-kind="deck"]'); if(kb) kb.click(); dlg.querySelector('#ndTitle').value='덱 시험 새'; dlg.querySelector('#ndOk').click(); await until(async()=>{const o=document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on'); return o&&o.textContent.trim()==='덱 시험 새'&&!document.querySelector('.nd-back');},8000); const on=document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on'); const id=on&&on.textContent.trim()==='덱 시험 새'?on.dataset.deck:null; window.__newDeck=id; return id && /^[a-z][0-9a-f]{7}$/.test(id) ? true : 'on='+(on&&on.textContent)+' id='+(on&&on.dataset.deck);

steps.name: 오른쪽 클릭 메뉴: 새 덱·제목·복제·시작 덱·삭제(이름 바꾸기 없음, 줄임표 없음)
steps.js: const b=document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on'); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu',{bubbles:true,clientX:200,clientY:100})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const labels=[...document.querySelectorAll('#menu button')].map(x=>x.textContent.trim()); const ok=labels.some(l=>l.startsWith('제목 바꾸기'))&&labels.some(l=>l.startsWith('복제'))&&labels.some(l=>l==='시작 덱으로')&&labels.some(l=>l.startsWith('덱 삭제'))&&labels.includes('새 덱')&&!labels.some(l=>/이름\(id\)|…/.test(l)); document.body.click(); return ok ? true : labels.join('|')

steps.name: 시작 덱으로 → ★ 표시 · 해제 메뉴로 바뀜
steps.js: const b=document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on'); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu',{bubbles:true,clientX:200,clientY:100})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); [...document.querySelectorAll('#menu button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='시작 덱으로').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); const on=document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on'); const star=on.textContent.trim().startsWith('★'); on.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu',{bubbles:true,clientX:200,clientY:100})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const off=[...document.querySelectorAll('#menu button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim().endsWith('시작 덱 해제')); if(off) off.click(); await until(()=>star && off && !document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on').textContent.includes('★'), 3200); return star && off && !document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on').textContent.includes('★') ? true : 'star='+star+' off='+!!off

steps.name: 복제 → 새 탭 '덱 시험 새 (복사)'
steps.js: window.prompt=(m,d)=>d; const f0=window.fetch, rs=[]; window.fetch=async(u,o={})=>{const r=await f0(u,o); if(String(u).includes('/api/decks')&&String(o.method||'GET').toUpperCase()==='POST'){let e='';try{e=(await r.clone().json()).error||'';}catch(x){} rs.push(r.status+(e?' '+e:''));} return r;}; try { const b=document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on'); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('contextmenu',{bubbles:true,clientX:200,clientY:100})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); [...document.querySelectorAll('#menu button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim().startsWith('복제')).click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1200)); const on=document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on'); window.__copyDeck=on&&on.dataset.deck; const ok = on && on.textContent.trim()==='덱 시험 새 (복사)' && on.dataset.deck!==window.__newDeck; if (ok) return true; const tabs=[...document.querySelectorAll('#deckTabs button[data-deck]')].map(x=>x.dataset.deck+(x.classList.contains('on')?'*':'')).join(','); return ('on='+(on&&on.textContent.trim())+'('+(on&&on.dataset.deck)+') · new='+window.__newDeck+' · POST /api/decks='+JSON.stringify(rs)+' · tabs='+tabs).slice(0,199); } finally { window.fetch=f0; }

steps.name: 정리: 시험 덱 둘 삭제 · 표·글머리 탭으로
steps.js: window.confirm=()=>true; for(const id of [window.__copyDeck, window.__newDeck]){ await fetch('/api/decks',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({action:'delete',id})}); } await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); location.hash='#tbltest/1'; await until(()=>document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on') && document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on').dataset.deck==='tbltest', 8000); return document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on') && document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on').dataset.deck==='tbltest' ? true : ('on='+((document.querySelector('#deckTabs button.on')||{dataset:{}}).dataset.deck||'(없음)')+' · hash='+location.hash+' · S.id='+(window.NexaStudioLink&&window.NexaStudioLink.S.id)+' · tabs='+[...document.querySelectorAll('#deckTabs button[data-deck]')].map(b=>b.dataset.deck).join(',')).slice(0,199)
